info.name: List listings for an account feed

params.name: account_name
params.description: The account name identifying the feed.

params.name: listing_type
params.description: Restricts returned listings to sale and/or rental listings.

params.name: listing_status
params.description: Filters listings by conventional listing statuses (comma-separated): active, in_contract, temp_off_market, perm_off_market, closed, expired, future, lead.

params.name: updated_since
params.description: Excludes listings whose updated_at is less than this ISO 8601 value.

params.name: updated_before
params.description: Excludes listings whose updated_at is greater than this ISO 8601 value.

params.name: page_size
params.description: Maximum number of listing records returned per response (0-200).

items.docs: Returns listings for the given account feed, filtered by listing type, status, and modification window, with page-based pagination. The response includes a total count and an array of Listing objects.
